business_overview.one_sentence: The group manufactures and sells architectural glass products in the PRC, mainly energy-efficient safety glass.

segments.name: Glass products
segments.business_substance: Single operating segment; sales of energy-efficient safety glass and smart glass in the PRC.

business_overview.revenue_model: Direct sale of glass products; revenue recognised when goods are delivered to customer specified locations; normal credit term is 60 to 180 days.
business_notes: Energy-efficient safety glass contributed RMB216.085 million, 99.5% of 2023 revenue.
The largest customer contributed 20.7% of sales; five largest customers contributed 43.9%.

non_recurring_items.business_substance: Other net income; not treated as core recurring operating cash profit for owner earnback.

non_recurring_items.item: Fair value gain on FVTOCI equity instrument
non_recurring_items.business_substance: Recognised in other comprehensive income, not profit or loss.
non_recurring_items.source: Annual Report 2023 consolidated statement of comprehensive income and note 25

funds_assets.item: Cash at banks and on hand
funds_assets.business_substance: Only disclosed cash and cash equivalents; RMB funds are subject to PRC exchange and remittance restrictions.

operating_assets.business_substance: Raw materials RMB30.741 million and finished goods RMB129.449 million for glass manufacturing.

operating_assets.item: Trade receivables measured at amortised cost
operating_assets.business_substance: Receivables from glass product sales; normal credit term 60 to 180 days.
Operating deposits and prepayments; large increase versus 2022 and a key cash conversion drag.
PRC glass manufacturing plant, machinery and equipment; part pledged for loans and sale-and-leaseback.

investment_assets.business_substance: 5% unlisted PRC private entity equity interest acquired by contribution in kind; Level 3 valuation; held for long-term purposes.
investment_assets.source: Annual Report 2023 notes 14 and 25, text lines 4880-4888 and 5930-6022

other_assets.business_substance: Tax asset from accruals/provisions and deferred revenue.
other_assets.source: Annual Report 2023 balance sheet and note 21(b)

financing_liabilities.business_substance: Current secured bank loans; guaranteed by controlling family parties and partly secured by PPE.
Secured borrowings from sale-and-leaseback of machinery; accounted for as financing rather than asset sale.

operating_liabilities.business_substance: Trade payables RMB2.147 million and other payables/accruals RMB26.161 million.

other_liabilities.source: Annual Report 2023 balance sheet and note 21(a)

other_liabilities.business_substance: Government grants related to long-term assets.

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Reported profits were stable, but 2022-2023 operating cash flow was negative while revenue was broadly stable. Receivables, deposits and prepayments absorbed cash; therefore owner-earnback profit requires a heavy haircut.

evidence.source: Annual Report 2023 consolidated income statement, RMB'000
evidence.note: Energy-efficient safety glass products were 99.5% of revenue.
Cash at banks and on hand.
Bank loans plus sale-and-leaseback other borrowings.

evidence.source: Annual Report 2023 consolidated cash flow statement, RMB'000
evidence.note: Net cash used in operating activities.

gaps: The 2023 annual report provides 2021 profit in the financial summary but not 2021 operating cash flow or capital expenditure.
No parent/subsidiary cash split is disclosed beyond PRC remittance restrictions; cash is treated conservatively as operating required.
The unlisted FVTOCI investee is not named in the extracted facts beyond the 5% private PRC equity description and Level 3 valuation.
